rows.quote: Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was used to explore the causal relationship between feature DEGs and UC based on data derived from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) (ieu-a-32, 20,464 normal controls and 6968 UC patients), including expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) and protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL).
rows.coder_note: Rules B and G: OpenGWAS accession ieu-a-32 is listed by no dictionary row and stays absent although its UC counts (6968 cases, 20,464 controls) equal those of a listed row.
